title: Foodfolio — Food Collaboration Outreach Workspace
summary: A local-first workspace for discovering Singapore food businesses, extracting sourced contacts, drafting personalised outreach with Gemini, and tracking collaborations. A Python backend coordinates PostgreSQL records, reviewed Gmail delivery, and manual social outreach through a TypeScript dashboard.
role: Full-stack developer and project owner; AI-assisted implementation with a Lovable-generated frontend design skeleton.
coverAlt: Foodfolio Discover screen in Demo Mode, showing a Singapore cafe search field, workspace navigation and sample business cards.
coverCaption: Existing application screenshot: Discover in Demo Mode with sample businesses. This screen makes no live Google Places requests and does not demonstrate live email delivery.
contributions: Developed the Python/FastAPI backend and PostgreSQL persistence, including restaurant identity handling, migrations and outreach workflow rules.
Integrated Google Places discovery and bounded website contact extraction with retained source URLs.
Integrated structured Gemini drafting with creator-profile snapshots, output validation and deterministic message assembly.
Implemented Gmail OAuth with PKCE, encrypted refresh-token storage, explicit message approval and send-reservation safeguards.
Adapted the Lovable-generated frontend skeleton and connected its TypeScript workflows to the backend for discovery, outreach and tasting planning.
Developed backend and frontend tests and the Docker Compose local setup with AI coding assistance.
